title: Trees and Forests
text:
Trees are very important for our planet. They give us clean air and shade in summer. Many birds live in trees. Forests can be home to many animals.

People must protect the forests. When people cut too many trees, animals lose their homes. We can plant new trees in our parks. Plants help the environment in many ways.

questions.text: What happens when people cut too many trees?
What can you infer about the environment without forests?
options: It would be a worse home for animals
It would be safer for people

questions.text: Why do people plant new trees in parks?

vocabulary.definition: tall plants with a trunk and branches
animals with feathers and wings that can fly
the natural world around us, such as air, water and land

paragraph_translations: Drzewa są bardzo ważne dla naszej planety. Dają nam czyste powietrze i cień latem. Wiele ptaków mieszka na drzewach. Lasy mogą być domem dla wielu zwierząt.
Ludzie muszą chronić lasy. Kiedy ludzie wycinają zbyt wiele drzew, zwierzęta tracą swoje domy. Możemy sadzić nowe drzewa w parkach. Rośliny pomagają środowisku na wiele sposobów.
